name: Kellogg's Tour 1988
summary: Kellogg's Tour 1988 turns a long cycling race into a sporting challenge in which success depends not only on endurance, but also on maintaining strong performances across many stages. On the journey from Newcastle to Westminster, it is not just about moving forward, but also about battling for special classifications and prized jerseys that give each section added importance. That blend of stage-by-stage thinking, overall ranking, and the pursuit of different honors gives the game an appealing racing character that goes beyond simple speed.
